_about: ElevenLabs sound-effect spec for Ghost Duels: one entry per file in ghost-duels-web/assets/sfx. 'use' is how game.js plays it (sound module, use(...) calls), 'gen' is the request, 'judge' the measurable bar a take must clear. See README.md in this folder.

defaults.key: A minor (game scale: A Phrygian; music: Spooky Carousel, A minor, ~96 BPM); wins resolve to A major
defaults.style: Haunted Halloween casino: haunted bells, ghost choir, pipe organ, bone and wood, chains, thunder, green spectral magic

sounds.name: click
sounds.role: Any button press (bet +/-, menus, autoplay, info).

gen.prompt: Short crisp UI click for a slot game button: a dry wooden tap with a tiny bone rattle and a faint bright tick on top. Clean, satisfying, punchy, starts instantly, no reverb, no tail.

sounds.name: spin
sounds.role: Spin pressed: the old board falls out before the new symbols drop. Every round, thousands of times.

gen.prompt: One-shot slot machine spin: a sharp punchy thud hits instantly at the very first moment, then a fast downward whoosh as the old reels drop away, with a quick bone rattle and a spectral swirl. Short, tight, energetic, Halloween casino, loud, punchy.

judge.note: not too bright: it repeats every spin

sounds.name: land
sounds.role: A reel comes to rest. 7 per spin, faster in turbo; the game raises it a little per reel.

gen.prompt: One-shot slot reel stop: a single hard, punchy coffin-lid knock with a crisp bone snap and a tight deep thud. Satisfying, dry, very short, starts instantly, no reverb, no tail.

judge.note: needs mid-range knock, phone speakers drop the low thud

sounds.name: land_heavy
sounds.role: A VS reel or a ghost crate slams down (also under every crate landing in the bonus).

gen.prompt: Instant heavy impact: a stone tomb slab slams down hard, a deep boom and cracking stone at the very first moment, then a short chain rattle and green magic sparks. Short, punchy, epic, Halloween, loud.

sounds.name: chime
sounds.keep: Pitched note source: the game plays it as A5 and transposes it into the win arpeggios (2-5 notes, scale steps) and the small duel sting. A generated sound has no exact pitch and usually more than one note; keep the designed bell. Possible later: generate one bell strike and retune it to exactly 880 Hz.
sounds.role: Win arpeggios, small duel win.

sounds.name: crystal
sounds.keep: Pitched note source (A5) for runes landing and being collected, stepped up the scale per rune. Same reason as chime.
sounds.role: Bonus: rune lands, rune collected.

sounds.name: tumble
sounds.role: Winning symbols vanish (every cascade step).

prompts: One-shot: a bright juicy pop as winning slot symbols burst, with a quick sparkle shower and a tiny coin jingle. Starts instantly, satisfying, rewarding, short, punchy, casino game.
One-shot: winning slot symbols shatter like glass into glittering sparkles, a crisp crystal crash with a quick magical shimmer tail. Starts instantly, satisfying, short, punchy.
One-shot: a ghostly poof of green smoke with a bright magical sparkle burst and a soft upward whoosh. Starts instantly, short, satisfying, Halloween game.

sounds.name: charge
sounds.role: The small VS symbol charges up, right before it bursts into a VS reel.

prompts: Reverse cymbal swell: a reversed crash cymbal and a reversed magic whoosh, quiet at first and growing louder and louder for one second, ending abruptly at its loudest point. Electric green energy crackle, tension, Halloween.

Fast energy charge-up riser: a reversed sparkle shimmer and a crackling electric hum swelling from silence to a loud peak, rising in pitch, cut off sharply at the end. Power about to explode, game sound effect.

judge.note: must end at its loudest, the burst follows

sounds.name: burst
sounds.role: The VS reel bursts open. Also reused, slightly higher (rate 1.15), as the slam that starts a duel.

prompts: Instant cinematic impact hit: a huge punchy boom with a bright glass shatter and an explosion of magic sparkles, short deep tail. Epic, exciting feature reveal for a slot game, loud, wide stereo.
Instant explosion: a massive punchy boom and a crack of green lightning, flying debris and a short rumbling tail. Powerful, exciting game sound effect, loud, punchy.
Wild reel unlocked: an instant heavy metal gate slam and a magical burst of energy with a bright sparkle shimmer, short tail. Exciting, powerful, casino game, loud, punchy.

sounds.name: clash
sounds.role: Two duel fighters collide; harder and lower the higher the stakes.

gen.prompt: One-shot ghost duel clash: two blades collide with a huge metallic impact, a shockwave boom and a short spectral wail, sparks flying, metal ringing out. Aggressive, thrilling Halloween battle arena, loud, punchy, wide stereo.

sounds.name: wail
sounds.role: A duel fighter is knocked out (the other one wins the round).

gen.prompt: One-shot knockout: a heavy punchy hit, then a ghost's long descending wail fading away as it is banished. Dramatic and satisfying for the winner, Halloween battle, loud.

sounds.name: toll
sounds.role: Deep bell toll. Also played an octave up (rate 2) under character wins and crate landings.
sounds.pitched: A2 (110 Hz): retune the chosen take to exactly A2; reject takes more than 1 semitone off or with more than one strike

gen.prompt: A single deep haunted church bell toll, one strike only, note A2, long ringing decay with a dark cathedral reverb. Powerful, ominous, majestic, high-quality professional recording.

sounds.keep: ElevenLabs ignored the note (2 takes came out around E, 5 semitones off); the designed toll is exactly A2, which the game needs because it also plays it an octave up under wins.

sounds.name: sting
sounds.role: Duel won by the pirate (tier 2 multipliers x20-x100): the music dips under it.

prompts: Short victory fanfare: an instant brass hit and a bright rising arpeggio of bells into a triumphant major chord, with a sparkle and a coin jingle. Rewarding, exciting slot game win, loud, punchy.
Duel victory stinger: an instant ringing sword clash, then a triumphant ghost choir shout and a shower of coins and sparkles. Rewarding, exciting, Halloween casino, loud, punchy, wide stereo.
Win stinger for a slot game: an instant bright chime hit, a fast ascending bell arpeggio and a big major chord with a sparkle tail. Triumphant, rewarding, exciting, loud, punchy, clean.

sounds.name: sting_devil
sounds.role: The devil wins a duel (x150-x1000), the devil enters as challenger (rate 0.92), and the layer on top of the max win.

gen.prompt: Starts with an instant massive demonic hit: a brass and choir braam slams at the very first moment, with a deep pipe organ pedal and a monstrous growl, then a ringing gong. Terrifying yet triumphant, epic Halloween jackpot moment, loud, wide stereo.

sounds.name: fanfare
sounds.role: Free spins (Ghost Crates bonus) triggered: the music dips 3.2 s under it.

prompts: Bonus unlocked jackpot stinger: an instant huge impact with a ringing jackpot bell, then a triumphant brass and choir chord, coins and sparkles exploding, and a rising magical whoosh at the end. Euphoric, epic slot game bonus, loud, wide stereo.

Free spins triggered: an instant thunder crack and a church bell strike, a ghostly choir shout, then rapid ringing bells and a cascade of coins and sparkles. Euphoric, exciting Halloween casino bonus, loud, punchy, wide stereo.
Epic bonus reveal: an instant cinematic braam hit, a magical sparkle explosion and a fast rising arpeggio of bells into a big triumphant chord. Euphoric, rewarding slot game, loud, wide stereo.

finish._why: the chosen take has half a second of silence between the explosion and the bells

sounds.name: bigwin
sounds.role: Big win (20x bet or more): a money payout. The max win adds sting_devil on top. The music dips 3-4 s.

gen.prompt: BIG WIN money payout: starts instantly with a loud cash register cha-ching, then a huge cascade of gold coins pouring and clinking into a metal slot machine tray, jackpot bells ringing and sparkling chimes. Euphoric, rich, rewarding casino jackpot, loud, punchy, wide stereo.

sounds.name: heartbeat
sounds.role: Bonus: a life is lost (a spin without a hit). A small setback, so dramatic but short, never sad.

prompts: One-shot life lost: a sharp glass crack and a heavy heartbeat thump, then a short descending ghostly whoosh. Tense, dramatic game sound effect, punchy, clear mid-range, not sad.
One-shot: two quick heartbeat thumps with a bright cracking sound on top and a short eerie whisper fading away. Tense, dramatic, Halloween game, punchy, clear on small speakers.

sounds.name: crumble
sounds.role: Bonus end: runes without a crate crumble to dust. A small loss, so understated on purpose.

gen.prompt: Old stone runes crumbling to dust: a short dry grinding crumble with falling grit and a soft low thud. Quick, light, Halloween.

sounds.name: challenger
sounds.role: The ghost pirate enters as challenger in a duel (the music dips 1.6 s).

gen.prompt: Ghost pirate challenger entrance that starts instantly with a cannon boom, then a deep ship horn blast, rattling chains, a dark organ chord and a ghostly pirate laugh. Menacing, exciting, Halloween, cinematic, loud, punchy.

sounds.name: banner
sounds.role: A banner appears (round and feature announcements); the music dips 2 s.

gen.prompt: Banner reveal: a fast rising spectral whoosh into a bright haunted bell hit with a sparkle burst. Exciting announcement, Halloween casino, A major, punchy, loud, wide stereo.

sounds.name: fs_land
sounds.role: An FS (scatter) symbol lands; the loudest effect, each further FS in a spin 2 semitones higher (up to an octave).
sounds.note: The current file is built from an ElevenLabs download (audio-src/Magical_scatter_symb_#4...mp3) and peaks at +0.8 dBFS (clips). Check under which plan it was generated.

prompts: Slot scatter symbol landing: an instant heavy thud with a bright magical bell strike and a shimmering sparkle burst, short shiny tail. Exciting, rewarding, special, casino game, loud, punchy, clean.
Special symbol lands: an instant deep impact and a glowing magical chime chord with a quick rising shimmer. Exciting, mysterious, Halloween slot game, loud, punchy.
Bonus symbol landing: an instant punchy hit with a golden coin ring and a crystal sparkle, short and bright. Exciting, rewarding slot game, loud, clean.

judge.note: must still sound good an octave up: not too much extreme high end

finish._why: the game plays it up to an octave higher; the bright top would turn shrill

sounds.name: edge
sounds.role: Tease: one FS away, under each teasing reel (2.4 s body plus tail), a semitone higher per further reel; the music dips.

prompts: Suspense riser for a slot game: quiet at first and growing louder and higher for two and a half seconds, a heartbeat speeding up, rising tremolo strings and a reverse cymbal swell, then a sudden stop and a short dark tail. Edge-of-your-seat anticipation.

Tension build-up: a fast ticking clock and a pulsing heartbeat speeding up over a rising synth drone and a reverse whoosh, getting louder until a sudden cut at two and a half seconds. Anticipation, casino game, Halloween.
